Relay Open Relay

Help & FAQ

Last updated: 17 November 2026

Relay is a free real-time chat app in the spirit of Telegram and Discord, built and run by Hardouch Anas as a personal project.

Getting started

How do I start a chat?

Search for a friend's username in the search box. They get a friend request; once they accept, you can chat, call and play together.

How do I make a group?

Press the pencil (or the + in the left bar on a computer) → New group, then pick friends. Group admins can add people, share an invite link, turn on slow mode or let only admins post.

Can I install Relay like an app?

Yes. On Android/Chrome use “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”; on iPhone open the Share menu → “Add to Home Screen”. It then works like an app, with notifications and offline reading.

Privacy and security

What is a secret chat?

An end-to-end encrypted 1:1 chat. Open a chat's info → Secret chat. Its keys exist only on your two devices, so nobody else, not even the site owner, can read it. It only works on the device where you started it.

Who can read my normal chats?

The people in them, and the site owner when reviewing a report (every access is logged). Admins can't read messages. See the Privacy Policy.

How do I protect my account?

Settings → Privacy & security: turn on two-step verification, check your signed-in devices and sign out the ones you don't recognise. You can also set a passcode lock on a device.

How do I block or report someone?

Open their profile → Block or Report. To report a single message, press and hold it (or right-click) → Report.

Your data

How do I download my data?

Settings → Your data → Export. You get a JSON file with your profile, devices and messages.

How do I delete my account?

Settings → Your data → Delete account. It's immediate and can't be undone.

Fun

How do I play a game with a friend?

In a chat, press the paperclip → Game / Watch. Team games (Word Team, Crack the Code, Pair Up) are played by everyone in the chat together; head-to-head games are you against whoever moves first.

How do I change a chat's theme?

Open the chat's info → Theme. Everyone in the chat sees the theme you choose. If you prefer your own colors, turn off “Show chat themes” in Settings → Appearance.

Contact

Questions, bugs or ideas: github.com/Anas2103/Relay/issues. Security issues: please report them privately, see security.txt.
